description: Browse the Radix Wiki by tag path rather than by keyword: every page under a branch, newest first by default. `tagPath` matches the branch and everything beneath it; omit it to walk the whole wiki. Sort by title for an A–Z pass. Same rows as search_wiki, with `totalPages`, `hasMore` and `nextPage`. Defaults: page 1, pageSize 20 (max 100).

tagPath.description: The branch to list, e.g. a path from get_categories. Includes its descendants.

name: list_pages
title: List pages
